title: Carry-forward decision for external validation
frozen_before: any external image was acquired, cached or scored. The decision is a function of Phase 4 artefacts only.

governing_clauses.blueprint_status_board: pre-condition: carry the best-calibrated arm, not the most accurate (Phase 4 sec.4.7)
governing_clauses.phase4_s47: Phase 5 should carry the best-calibrated configuration, not the most accurate one, into external validation
governing_clauses.rq3_external_half: whether the uncertainty ranking is preserved outside the training distribution

literal_rule_evaluation.rule: select argmin ECE on the pooled contested stratum
literal_rule_evaluation.why: C3 attains the lowest contested ECE (19.413 points) but is 6.446 points UNDER-confident on unanimous images, beyond the 5.0-point tolerance. Its calibration is therefore substantially a global confidence shift, not evidence that it knows which images are hard. Carrying it alone would carry an artefact into the external test.

decision.supersedes: the single-arm reading of Phase 4 sec.4.7 recorded on the blueprint status board
rationale: RQ3's external half is a question about RANKING preservation. A ranking cannot be measured with one arm, so a single-arm carry-forward would make the phase's own research question untestable.

The literal best-calibrated rule selects C3, which is disqualified above as a global confidence shift. Carrying every arm exposes that pattern externally instead of concealing it behind a single selected model.
Phase 5 is inference-only. The compute argument that justifies selecting one arm during training does not apply: the whole carry-forward is 15 forward passes.
Carrying C0 preserves the Phase 2/3 reference arm, so the external drop can be quoted against the internal baseline the rest of the thesis uses.
decision.primary_arm_rationale: C2 is the RQ2 treatment arm and the soft-target construction the thesis is about. Headline external numbers are quoted for C2 with every other arm tabulated alongside; C3 is retained explicitly as the calibration control, not as a candidate model.

inherited_outstanding_from_phase4.item: statistical power on the RQ2 primary endpoint
inherited_outstanding_from_phase4.status: NOT fixed by this amendment, and not fixable by re-analysis
inherited_outstanding_from_phase4.detail: the pooled contested stratum is 550 images clustered within patients, and no precision or power statement was pre-registered. The realised half-width on C2-C3 cannot resolve an effect of the size observed. Phase 5 should pre-register a target precision.
see P4-AMD-3; requires the Phase 4B retraining amendment.

binding_on_phase5: no fine-tuning, adaptation or self-training on external data before the clean transfer numbers are recorded and frozen; any adaptation arm is a SEPARATE, later, declared comparison against these numbers
Phase 2 training-set normalisation statistics reused unchanged
all intervals >=1,000 resamples (blueprint sec.6; see phase4_amendment P4-AMD-1)
